data.title: S004: AS independent-set obstruction, complete multipartite ASH*, and verified losing frontiers
data.body:
Universal ASH* remains open for stacking and clearing. S004 proves an almost-stacked non-stackable witness of mass 3k for every independent set of size k>=2, allowing edges outside that independent set. With credited source threshold formulas, this establishes ASH* for all complete multipartite graphs. Novelty and Lean certification are not claimed.

The independent cold audit confirms the printed P4/bull counterexamples, true thresholds 15, and required smallest-order boundaries. Printed-form mathematics Phase 1 passes separately; universal mathematics remains in progress. No later stage or external contact occurred.

Complete sparse losing-layer certificates resolve all eight missing order-seven stacking and three clearing cases. Combined with S003, all 853/853 stacking and 809/809 clearing thresholds at order seven are independently complete. Selected larger values: C9 37/46, triangle with a length-five tail stack 128, two triangles joined by a length-three path 36/36. C10 is complete only through mass 16; triangle-tail clear >140 remains undetermined. All 21 certificates, including cutoffs, were independently replayed, covering 11,726,545 losing states.

Validation: cold full reverse winning DP and forward closure; original winning-sequence and closed-set replay; 233 independent-set witness tests; full reverse winning base comparison on all 21 cases; independent packed canonical-parent completeness replay; governance, source/claim mirrors and 65 evidence/code hashes. The workflow repeats these checks. Failed extremal, block, invariant and algebraic assumptions are documented, with a complete strictly FUTURE S005 handoff.

Exactly one authored commit is proposed to main. Actual hosted check and merge/main results are recorded below.

data.title: S003 — October source gate; certified counterexamples to the printed ASH; critical-form evidence
data.body:
One atomic S003 session commit (`6ac5553`, parent `ce7a9e1`).

## Outcome
- **Printed ASH is false for both halves.** This is October Hypothesis 3.2, which is identical in content to April 9.1.
  - **Stack:** on P4 (0-1-2-3), all 32 almost-stacked configurations of size 12 are stackable, but (1,0,2,9) is not. stack(P4)=15.
  - **Clear:** on the bull graph, all 80 almost-stacked configurations of size 12 are clearable, but (1,9,0,2,0) is not. clear=15.
  - Finite certificates are in `evidence/S003/`. They are replayed by an independent checker, and CI now re-runs that check.
  - The **Lean proof and an independent cold audit are pending** (S004). **Phase 1 is NOT advanced.**
- **The critical form ASH\* is open.** This is the form the authors' public atlas code actually tests. It is proved for:
  - trees, by the earlier TreeStack theorem plus October Thm 5.2;
  - complete bipartite graphs (new Thm 10 + April Thm 8.2).
  It is computed true on the full n≤7 atlas and on all connected 8-vertex graphs with threshold ≤26.
- The October source gate is now closed for statements; the October PDF is read in full and not mirrored.
- **S002 erratum:** C8 + chord 0–4 is non-bipartite, with stack = clear = 23.
- New exact values include stack(C8)=31, clear(C7)=22 and Petersen 15/15.

## Review pointers
- `research/S003_AS_GAP_AND_ATTACKS.md`: complete proofs, dependency DAG, failed-assumption ledger.
- `research/S003_SOURCE_RECONCILIATION.md`
- `sessions/S003/{INPUT,PLAN,PLAN_AMENDMENT_1,CLOSEOUT}.md`: the plan hashes are re-verified by the validator.
- `tools/cam_s003_*`, `evidence/S003/HASHES.md`
- `authoritative/NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md`: the S004 handoff, FUTURE and UNEXECUTED.

Nothing was sent to the authors, Palomar or arXiv, and no novelty or priority claim is made.

  and on all n=8 graphs with threshold <=26, and remains open.

  AS memo solver; exact stack(C8)=31; S002 bipartiteness erratum for C8+chord 0-4.
